display.$description: Display mode for the framed code listing.

container-type.$description: Container-query participation for the responsive split panes.

margin-block-start.$description: Space before the code block in document flow.

margin-block-end.$description: Space after the code block in document flow.

canvas.$description: Frame background visible around the caption and listing.

ink.$description: Default foreground inherited by the code block.

bar-border-color.$description: Divider color between the top bar and code listing.

bar-border-width.$description: Divider width between the top bar and code listing.

bar-border-style.$description: Divider style between the top bar and code listing.

bar-min-height.$description: Minimum top-bar height, aligned with accessible action targets.

bar-padding-inline.$description: Inline padding inside the top bar.

bar-padding-block.$description: Block padding inside the top bar.

bar-gap.$description: Space between the label and action region.

bar-flex-wrap.$description: Wrapping behavior for the label, view selector, and actions.

bar-font-family.$description: Font family for Code Block-owned top-bar labels.

bar-font-size.$description: Font size for Code Block-owned top-bar labels.

bar-font-weight.$description: Font weight for Code Block-owned top-bar labels.

bar-line-height.$description: Line height for Code Block-owned top-bar labels.

bar-letter-spacing.$description: Letter spacing for the visible code-block label.

bar-text-transform.$description: Text transformation for the visible code-block label.

actions-gap.$description: Space between repeated slotted actions and the copy action.

view-gap.$description: Space between the tablist and the Split preference control.

code-padding-inline.$description: Inline padding around the code listing.

code-padding-block.$description: Block padding around the code listing.

code-tab-size.$description: Number of spaces represented by a tab in code content.

preview-ink.$description: Default foreground inherited by rendered preview content.

preview-font-size.$description: Default font size inherited by rendered preview content.

preview-font-weight.$description: Default font weight inherited by rendered preview content.

preview-padding-inline.$description: Inline padding around rendered preview content.

preview-padding-block.$description: Block padding around rendered preview content.

preview-min-block-size.$description: Minimum block size of the preview pane.

preview-overflow.$description: Overflow behavior for rendered preview content.

preview-border-block-start-width-wide.$description: Stacking divider width removed when Split view reaches the wide container condition.

split-divider-ink-hover.$description: Visible split divider color on pointer hover.

split-divider-ink-active.$description: Visible split divider color while pressed or keyboard-focused.

split-divider-width.$description: Width of the visible split divider line.

split-divider-style.$description: Style of the divider between stacked compact panes.

split-divider-target-size.$description: Inline hit area centered over the visible split divider.

split-divider-cursor.$description: Cursor displayed over the draggable split divider.

split-grip-canvas.$description: Background of the compact visual grip centered on the divider.

split-grip-ink.$description: Color of the six-dot drag indicator inside the divider grip.

split-grip-border-color.$description: Border color of the compact divider grip.

split-grip-border-width.$description: Border width of the compact divider grip.

split-grip-border-radius.$description: Corner radius of the compact divider grip.

split-grip-inline-size.$description: Visible inline size of the divider grip; the pointer target remains larger.

split-grip-block-size.$description: Visible block size of the divider grip.

split-grip-icon-inline-size.$description: Inline size of the six-dot indicator inside the grip.

split-grip-icon-block-size.$description: Block size of the six-dot indicator inside the grip.

focus-color.$description: Keyboard focus outline color for code-block controls.

focus-width.$description: Keyboard focus outline width for code-block controls.

focus-offset.$description: Keyboard focus outline offset kept inside the clipped component frame.
